title: Fake Chicken
author: Isaac Banner
problems: Row 3 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
Row 5 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 6 "robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 7 "robins start a half hey - rights in center, lefts on ends to face next neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey needs one dancer at each end of the line, one on each side.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
